start_frame: The sh014 position held and the framing widened: Alice lying flat in the spoil in the near frame with the burrow mouth ahead of her, her black ankle-strap shoes clean and whole in shot.
end_frame: The same frame with her gone into the black — head, shoulders and body taken by an opening that was somehow wide enough, her boots kicking once at the mouth and vanishing under the hedge.
constraint_honoured: 'No cutaway, no reaction shot — the first impossible thing on screen is played flat': the camera neither pushes in on the impossibility nor pulls back from it, and the shoes stay in frame to be paid off in S07.
movement_note: Static also guarantees sh016 can be the identical frame she just left, which is what makes the cut into S03 invisible.
